title: Security Intake Concierge: account-scoped SLA estimator and evidence prioritizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a concierge-style intake flow that automatically classifies incoming enterprise security/compliance asks (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires) at the account level, estimates an appropriate SLA lane, and assembles a prioritized evidence bundle for fast customer responses. The goal is to reduce manual triage time for Security/PM/Support, speed up sales cycles for enterprise customers, and standardize responses across hosting modes (hosted/dedicated/private).
acceptance_criteria: Incoming questionnaire submissions are automatically classified into sensitivity tiers (low/medium/high) using a rule+model hybrid with >85% alignment to Security team decisions during a 2-week pilot.

System returns an SLA recommendation (fast/standard/extended) and an evidence checklist populated with links to existing artifacts (SOC2 report, ISO statement, DPA template, KMS docs) for 90% of sample requests.
Evidence assembler can generate a downloadable bundle (PDF + attachments) and a short summary message suitable for account executives within 3 minutes of submission.
Console shows per-account intake metrics (avg triage time, SLA lane distribution, outstanding evidence items) and alerts when manual review needed.
Integration points: Confluence evidence catalog and Customer Vault (read-only) can be referenced programmatically; GitHub PR template and Slack alerts are wired for manual reviews.
Security & Legal sign-off on handling of customer PII/PHI in evidence bundles is obtained before GA.
tasks: Define signal taxonomy for sensitivity (data residency, PHI presence, contractual ask complexity).
Prototype classifier using existing labeled questionnaire dataset and fallback rules for key phrases.
Design evidence mapping: map sensitivity tiers to required artifacts and gaps.
Build API for evidence assembler that pulls from Confluence index and Customer Vault; include RBAC checks.
Console UI: per-account intake queue, SLA override controls, and evidence bundle preview.
Run 2-week pilot with 5 strategic accounts and collect decision alignment metrics and time-to-response.
Prepare runbook for Support/Security for edge cases and escalate path (manual review templates + Slack workflow).
